description:
Mr Tipster is a tip calculator with a mustache. Type the bill, pick a tip, split it with friends, and Mr Tipster lets you know how he feels about your generosity.

INSTANT RESULTS
• Start typing the moment the app opens
• Tip, total and each person's share update as you type

TIP YOUR WAY
• Quick picks from 15% to 25%, or any whole percentage from 0 to 50%
• Set your own default tip

SPLIT THE BILL
• Split between up to 50 people
• Each share is rounded up to the cent, so the group never comes up short
• Round up each share, or the total, to the next whole dollar, euro, pound or rupee, or the next ¥100

MR TIPSTER REACTS
His mustache droops at stingy tips, curls up at good ones, and does a little twirl when you're generous.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• Full VoiceOver support, with adjustable controls that announce the new total
• Voice Control and Switch Control actions
• Dynamic Type up to the largest accessibility sizes
• Increase Contrast and Reduce Motion support
• Light and dark mode, with light, dark and tinted app icons

ALSO
• Follows your device region's currency, or pick US dollar, euro, British pound, Japanese yen or Indian rupee
• Remembers your bill for 10 minutes
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking, works offline
promotionalText: Mr Tipster is back, completely rebuilt. Split any bill in seconds and see how he feels about your tip.
whatsNew:
